messages:
maria (partnerships): Quick sync — want to lock the SI co-sell handoff tempo for the new marketplace + hardware partner pilot. We saw a few dropped claims last month, need a tighter SLA and a simple mapping rule set.

jake (sales): +1. Can we set a hard claim window so reps know when to act? current ambiguity kills momentum. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sunil (solutions): Proposed: 24h claim window from intake for AE/SI to claim, otherwise auto-assign back to partnerships queue. If ARR > 250k or existing opportunity stage >= Demo -> immediate AE ownership.

olga (pm): That sounds reasonable. Two asks: 1) make sure SFDC tags get applied automatically (so reports don't break), 2) tie the handoff to marketplace listing status (if listing is PENDING, require partner PM approval for announcement).

maria (partnerships): Agreed on SFDC tags. Suggested minimal tag set: `si_cosell_claimed_by`, `si_cosell_claim_ts`, `si_marketplace_status`. Keeps things queryable.

sunil (solutions): Here's a tiny filter we can use in the intake lambda (pseudo-SQL):
```
SELECT lead_id FROM intake WHERE si_interest = true
AND (ARR > 250000 OR opportunity_stage IN ('Demo','POC'))
AND si_claim_ts IS NULL
ORDER BY created_ts ASC
LIMIT 1
```
If no claim within 24h, set `si_claimed_by = partnerships_queue`.

jake (sales): What about joint announcements? We need a guardrail so legal/marketing review doesn't delay deals. Nina, any quick rules?

nina (legal): For co-branded announces: legal needs a 3-business-day review window after partner PM signs off. For HW partners, add a 2-day compliance check if any export control flags. We can automate notifications but not skip review.

olga (pm): So timeline looks like: intake -> 24h claim -> 48h technical sync (if claimed) -> partner PM signoff -> 3 business days legal -> marketplace publish. We should make that visible in the intake card.

maria (partnerships): I'll add a simple status flow on the partnership intake card: NEW -> CLAIMED -> TECH_SYNC -> PM_SIGNOFF -> LEGAL_REVIEW -> MARKETPLACE_PENDING -> PUBLISHED. Each state has owner and SLA.

jake (sales): How do we handle contested accounts where both field rep and SI want ownership?

sunil (solutions): Proposed tie-breaker: existing AE engagement > 2 activities in last 30 days -> AE wins. Else, partner who logged the first technical activity gets priority. If still contested, partnerships ops mediates within 24h.

maria (partnerships): We'll codify that as a small adjudication microflow. Also adding a slack notification template for contested claims: `@partnerships-ops adjudicate: lead <id> contested by <partyA>, <partyB>`

olga (pm): Ops: can we surface a quick count metric on the intake card: "activities_last_30d" and "first_tech_activity_ts" so adjudication is obvious?

maria (partnerships): Yes. That will be part of the next sprint. Action items: 1) eng to add SFDC auto-tags (sunil), 2) intake UI status + metrics (olga), 3) legal SLA automation (nina), 4) partnerships ops adjudication playbook (maria).

redwood-bot: Reminder scheduled: Weekly SI-co-sell handoff cadence check-in — every Thursday 10:00 PT.

maria (partnerships): Thanks all. I'll draft a 1-pager with the mapping rules and the SLAs and drop in this thread by EOD tomorrow. If nobody objects, we'll start the 24h claim window trial next Monday. :thumbsup:
